profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, traded under the ticker CDNS, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000813672. On its own site the company describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and intellectual property for electronic design. It also points to its culture, citing Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work, and to its investment in sustainability.

The harvested site text does not name specific products, so no product line can be described from this material. The company's legal record lists no cases, and its recorded legal exposure sits in California, with 281 matters counted there. No MCP servers are listed for it.
